lines: •Raised FY2026 guidance to approximately 42.5% Total Revenue growth, $190.0 million of Adjusted Net Income (48.8% YoY growth)2, and $5.45–$5.50 of Adjusted Net Income per Diluted Share
•Introduced preliminary FY2027 guidance for Adjusted Net Income2 per Diluted Share of $7.20, representing 30.9%–32.1% growth over FY2026 guidance

We are raising FY2026 guidance for the fourth time, with Total Revenue growth now expected to reach approximately 42.5%, Adjusted Net Income of $190 million, and Adjusted Net Income per Diluted Share of $5.45–$5.50.
We are also introducing preliminary FY2027 guidance of $7.20 in Adjusted Net Income per Diluted Share.”
